thread:
marco-p: Kickoff: CloudSpark (SI) + ForgeNode (hardware) onramp. Goal: single publishable marketplace bundle that covers AWS/GCP + ForgeNode bare-metal, a compact Terraform module, a marketplace manifest (multi-cloud), Console quickstart, HSM/KMS notes, and an ops tuning snippet (autoscaler + batching). Sync Thu 9am PT. Who owns what?

anya-docs: I can own the marketplace manifest and Console quickstart. Will produce: GCP Solution package (deployment manager), AWS Marketplace AMI/CloudFormation mapping, and a short 'how it deploys' FAQ. Need partner-approved AMI IDs and a bare-metal image artifact URL.

kai-eng: I'll own the Terraform module + CI tests. Plan: minimal interface (region, node_profile, bare_metal_profile, hsm_provider, quant_profile, batching_hint). Will add outputs: telemetry_endpoint, deployment_id, model_variant. Will keep module <120 LOC and include a basic example for autoscaler tuning. WIP TF sketch:
```hcl
module "cloudspark_onramp" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkits/marketplace//cloudspark?ref=v0.1.0"
  region             = var.region
  node_profile       = var.node_profile
  bare_metal_profile = var.bare_metal_profile # maps to ForgeNode SKU
  hsm_provider       = var.hsm_provider      # none|partner|cloudkms
  quant_profile      = var.quant_profile     # fp16|int8_fast|int8_compat
  batching_hint      = var.batching_hint    # latency|throughput
}
```
Note: will include a `kv_cache` toggle and a `replica_count` input for throughput configs.

eli-sre: I'll draft the ops runbook and smoke tests. Need to know expected seq lengths and concurrency to tune batching. We'll add a canary label and a per-customer rollout toggle (feature-flag). For HSM: checklist snippet:
```
- confirm HSM vendor API endpoints and TLS certs
- verify key scoping and no shared root keys
- CI: perform HSM dry-bind (emulated) before GA
```

rebecca-comm: I'll draft the partner blurb + marketplace copy and coordinate partner legal for embargo. Prefer a staged rollout: EA (2 wks) -> GA. Request logos, approved quotes, and security blurb from partner PM by Tue.

anya-docs: Example marketplace manifest (manifest schema v2, WIP):
```yaml
name: cloudspark-forgenode-solution
description: "CloudSpark + ForgeNode onramp: validated inference stack (Redwood)"
providers:
  - aws:
      ami_map: { us-west-2: ami-0abc1234 }
  - gcp:
      solution: projects/marketplace-solutions/cloudspark-gcp
  - onprem:
      image_url: https://artifacts.forgenode/rdw/cloudspark-edge.img
inputs:
  - name: region
  - name: hsm_provider
```

ops-bot: Ticket ONRAMP-9001 created assigned to kai-eng, due in 6d.

marco-p: Action items recap:
- kai-eng: terraform module + tests + example autoscaler config
- anya-docs: marketplace manifests (aws/gcp/onprem) + Console quickstart
- eli-sre: ops runbook + smoke tests + HSM checklist
- rebecca-comm: partner blurb + embargo coordination
- marco-p: schedule partner sync + legal handoff

kai-eng: Quick question 1: repo name preference suggestions (<=16 chars)? thinking `cloudspark-onramp` is too long. ideas: `cs-onramp`, `spark-onramp`, `cloudspark-kit`. reply with fav.

anya-docs: `spark-kit` or `cs-onramp` look good. keeping it short helps marketplace slugs.

eli-sre: +1 `cs-onramp`. Also please attach expected perf numbers (p50 latency target) to PR so we can set smoke-test thresholds.

marco-p: Great. I'll consolidate and send invites for Thu. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
